SEO Specialist
Maplebox Commerce · Toronto, ON (Remote within Canada)

About the job
We're growing organic traffic for our 12 e-commerce brands and need a hands-on SEO Specialist.

You will
• Run keyword research and on-page optimization
• Conduct technical SEO audits and work with developers on fixes
• Report on organic performance in Google Analytics 4

You have
• 3+ years of SEO experience, ideally in e-commerce
• Expert knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Search Console
• Experience with content marketing and briefing writers
• Working knowledge of HTML
• Experience with Ahrefs or Semrush preferred
• WordPress experience is a plus

Why Maplebox
• Flexible hours, remote within Canada
• 4 weeks PTO, health and dental, RRSP matching
• $750 home office stipend

Maplebox welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request.
